gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-rowan: Scrawled and unfussy, Liu Jian Mao Cao looks like a quick note jotted in a margin, with letters packed shoulder to shoulder over Rowan, a friendly serif. Its best quality is that loose handwritten charm against a bookish body.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-spline-sans: Liu Jian Mao Cao traces every glyph with one uniform pen thickness, crowding its letters tightly together. Spline Sans follows as a plain sans with wide gaps at its curve ends, and the loose scribble against that tidy order is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-synonym: Liu Jian Mao Cao scribbles like a pen on paper, casual and packed tight. Synonym, a plain sans, counters that with a constant stripe of ink and generous curve openings, so one brings loose personality and the other steady, dependable clarity.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-outfit: Outfit bends its sans strokes like cable, with curves that finish well before they close, and sits beneath a heading of tightly packed pen-and-paper letters. Outfit's crisp geometry against Liu Jian Mao Cao's relaxed scrawl is the strongest thing about this pairing.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-plus-jakarta-san: Tightly crowded, pen-and-paper letters of one thickness give Liu Jian Mao Cao its casual, scribbled look. And Plus Jakarta Sans, a plain sans with monoline strokes and curve endings kept apart, lays a precise, orderly line beneath that handwriting.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-sora: Sora draws its sans letters with no swell at the corners, keeping the c and s widely parted under a casual, narrowly spaced handwritten heading. Precise geometry against relaxed scrawl is the whole story.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-space-grotesk: Liu Jian Mao Cao scrawls its relaxed, narrowly spaced letters at a single thickness, like a quick pen note on paper. Space Grotesk, a plain sans, sits beneath with open counters, so the loose hand gets a steady, geometric footing.
gen-gf-londrina-solid-fs-rowan: Chunky, tight and loud, Londrina Solid holds a constant weight like a stencil-cut channel, with its glyphs clasped close together. Rowan, a friendly serif, offers the opposite: open curves and a modest, readable shift between thick and thin.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-bhutuka-: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height. BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif with curvy, unclamped letters and a leisurely reading pace, stands against that squat heading with a more moderate lowercase height.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hepta-sl: Squat, loud and level, Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders above the x-height. Hepta Slab, a serif with open counters, stretched-out words and no thick-thin shifts, would read as a slow, dignified stroll, like a bent paperclip bookish at heart.
